say:2:1536029002:1.text: You're not human, are you? You've turned into one of those needle locusts too! Don't try to trick me!
say:2:1536029002:1.source_cn: 你、你也不是人，对不对？你也是针蝗变的！别想骗我，别想骗我！
say:2:1536029002:1.male: You're not human, are you? You've turned into one of those needle locusts too! Don't try to trick me!
say:2:1536029002:1.female: You're not human, are you? You've turned into one of those needle locusts too! Don't try to trick me!

say:3:1536029003:1.text: Somebody, help... I just want to go home...
say:3:1536029003:1.source_cn: 救命，谁来救救我……我要回家，我要回家……
say:3:1536029003:1.male: Somebody, help... I just want to go home...
say:3:1536029003:1.female: Somebody, help... I just want to go home...
